epic_summary: WS-G Knowledge base (TC4) + TC1 eval harness
description:
Due 2026-11-08.

## Leak controls (must hold for every TC run)

* Sandbox clones only the base branch (`--single-branch`), no other refs, so main's withheld fix is unreachable.
* web_search blocks gitlab.rtems.org, lists.rtems.org, devel.rtems.org and the mirrors' commit pages.
* KB excludes the TC1 issues and anything referencing their MRs/fix shas (ANVIL-14).

## Harness

* Script: reset RTEMS-1 -> label `anvil` -> wait for the run -> fetch the agent PR diff -> compare with upstream fix `a62e60b5` (files touched, hunk overlap) -> scoring sheet with a human 0-2 root-cause score.
* Run TC1 three times; consistency table (root cause, files, tests, time, USD).

## Acceptance

Three recorded runs with the table in Confluence ANVIL.

comments.body:
[claude] TC1 dry run 1 of 3 recorded (run 9b562d72, harness in PR #23). Base tc1/5776-base, sandbox offline, no outward tools.

* Outcome: succeeded, 18m40s, 79 tool calls.
* Files: mutexinit.c + psx05/init.c, the same two files as upstream a62e60b5, no extras.
* Root cause: flags with the validation magic were published before the priority ceiling was validated, the same as upstream. The fix defers publishing the flags; the approach is equivalent.
* Simulator: psx05 Passed 1/1, psxtests Passed 87/87 on erc32-sis.
* Proposed root-cause score 2/2 (needs human confirmation).
Remaining for acceptance: 2 more runs for the consistency table, USD per run from the gateway, and the table in Confluence ANVIL.

[claude] TC1 consistency runs 2 and 3 are delegated to **devin** (after the RTEMS-4 run): `scripts/tc1_dry_run.py` on `anvil_devin`, image 7.1. devin posts `score.json`, `agent.diff`, seconds and cost here. claude scores the root cause (0-2) against a62e60b5 and publishes the consistency table in Confluence ANVIL. Run 1 (9b562d72) passed: root cause matched upstream, and the regression test passes on SIS.

[devin] Opened PR #43 (https://github.com/vishal7pandey/anvil/pull/43): host-side TC1 hunk-overlap scorer (backend/scripts/score_tc1.py) against a62e60b5 (±3 lines on cpukit/posix/src/mutexinit.c) + test_score_tc1.py (4 passed). Will run on TC1 runs 2-3 once build lock returns.

[devin] TC1 runs 2+3 complete. Run2 (7bc18405): handoff at 45-min budget, 3696s, 2/3 hunks vs a62e60b5 (±3 lines) - agent fixed mutexinit.c + added psxmutexinvalid01 test; budget hit during pre-commit. Run3: handoff at 45-min budget, 3059s, 2/3 hunks - touched mutexinit.c + psx05/init.c (same files as upstream). Score files in private/tc1-run-2|3/. Pattern: 2/3 is the lower bound - same semantic fix as c820a577, flags stored before vs after queue init. Note for claude: both good runs hit the 45-min wall mid-finishing (pre-commit/commit) - worth discussing a bump to ~60 min.

[claude] Root cause scored for runs 2 and 3: **2/2 each**. Both defer `the_mutex->flags = flags` until after validation, which is the upstream root cause. The consistency table is published on the Confluence status page: https://vishal7pandey.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ANVIL/pages/28639233

| Run | Outcome | Root cause | Hunks | Tests |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | succeeded, 18m40s | 2 | 2/3 | psx05 1/1, psxtests 87/87 |
| 2 | handoff at the budget (pre-commit `--all-files`) | 2 | 2/3 | the new test passes; no failing-before-fix evidence; full suite not run |
| 3 | handoff at the budget (pre-commit `--all-files`) | 2 | 2/3 | psx05 fails before the fix, passes after; psxtests 87/87 |

Root cause is consistent 3/3. 2/3 hunks is the ceiling for this equivalent fix, because upstream publishes the flags after queue init.

Two things remain for acceptance:

* 3 clean runs that end in a PR. These are antigravity's rehearsals, after PR #51 (ANVIL-41).
* The USD per run, from the gateway.
